name: npr-cds-openapi
description: Community OpenAPI description of NPR's Content Distribution Service, with NPR's profile schemas vendored.

scripts.bundle: redocly bundle openapi.yaml -o dist/openapi.bundled.yaml && redocly bundle openapi.yaml --dereferenced -o dist/openapi.dereferenced.yaml
scripts.mcp: pnpm bundle && cortex mcp generate --output ./mcp-server && node scripts/after-generate.mjs && cd mcp-server && npm pkg set version=$(node -p "require('../package.json').cdsMcpVersion") && pnpm install && pnpm run build
